littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_reply_gate.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_reply_gate.name: astrbot_plugin_reply_gate
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_reply_gate.desc: 同会话串行判断与回复，期间新消息合为下一批，@ 必回，保留完整记忆与最新有效历史。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_meme_librar.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_meme_librar.name: astrbot_plugin_meme_library
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_meme_librar.desc: 自动收集群聊图片，维护名称和简短描述，支持看图选择、用法纠正、停用及原图路径读取。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_self_prompt.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_self_prompt.name: astrbot_plugin_self_prompt
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_self_prompt.desc: 人设、回复偏好与聊天示例由用户维护，机器人可主动维护昵称、自我认知和记事本，连续未修改时临时提醒。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_silence.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_silence.name: astrbot_plugin_silence
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_silence.desc: 让模型随时选择结束当前轮，可直接沉默或在任意工具操作后停止回复。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_usage_insig.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_usage_insig.name: astrbot_plugin_usage_insight
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_usage_insig.desc: 查看用量与费用明细，让机器人查询近期总 token、费用、个人花费及排行，复用现有 Key 自查账号余额。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_lcm.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_lcm.name: astrbot_plugin_lcm
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_lcm.desc: 统一提示来源与有效历史，完整存档、分层压缩、历史图片预算及原图查回。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_voice_reply.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_voice_reply.name: astrbot_plugin_voice_reply
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_voice_reply.desc: 让模型自行选择发送语音，支持发送后沉默，官方历史上下文保留实际说出的原文。

littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_tool_prompt.author: littleApricot
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_tool_prompt.name: astrbot_plugin_tool_prompts
littleApricot/astrbot_plugin_tool_prompt.desc: 统一管理插件、MCP 开关及内置工具原功能配置，自定义模型看到的工具及参数说明，支持恢复默认。
